import.subtitle: Choose how to handle existing folders. Nothing changes until you select Apply import.

import.behavior.label: Import behavior
import.mode.merge.title: Merge safely
import.mode.merge.description: Add new folders and update matches. Delete nothing.
import.mode.add.title: Add new only
import.mode.add.description: Create missing folders. Leave existing folders unchanged.
import.mode.replace.title: Replace exactly
import.mode.replace.description: Match the export. Folders absent from it may be deleted.
import.review.title: Review planned changes
import.safety.title: Safety options

import.safety.confirmation-description: Keep Apply locked until the review box is checked.

import.acknowledge.title: I reviewed this import

import.folderview3.preview-help: Discover an installed FolderView3 configuration or inspect a full-export JSON. Detection and preview are read-only; native organizer records and Docker autostart mutations remain excluded unless a later apply explicitly includes them.
import.folderview3.read-only-title: FolderView3 migration is read-only until you approve an apply plan.
import.folderview3.read-only-help: Detect an installed configuration or preview a FolderView3 export without writing any plugin or Unraid state.
import.folderview3.read-only-preview-hel: Detect an installed FolderView3 configuration or preview a FolderView3 export. Previewing never writes plugin or Unraid configuration.
import.folderview3.preview-export-help: You can still preview a FolderView3 full-export JSON from another server.
import.folderview3.preview-created: Migration report created without changing configuration.
import.folderview3.applied-help: The migration was verified and rollback checkpoints are available in Recovery.
import.folderview3.native-autostart: Also replace native Docker autostart entries and waits
import.folderview3.native-autostart-help: This host-level operation is optional and participates in automatic rollback.
import.folderview3.applying-help: Keep this page open while configuration is written, verified, or automatically restored.
import.folderview3.inspecting-help: This read-only preview may take a moment when custom styles are present.
import.folderview3.confirm-apply: Replace current FolderView Plus Docker folders, VM folders, compatible settings, start-order ownership, and Theme Workspace profile data? A rollback checkpoint and per-type backups will be created first.
import.folderview3.confirm-native-suffix: Native Docker autostart enablement and waits will also be replaced.
